user.title: Local grid utilization
user.description: Select the three voltage sensors and the target API.

data.battery_soc_percent_entity: Battery state of charge / SOC (%) – optional
data.pv_forecast_entity: PV forecast today (kWh) – optional, requires PV system size

data_description.smartmeter_model: Select a model or enter your own name (maximum 120 characters). Optional; the list does not guarantee compatibility.
data_description.battery_capacity: Enter the actual usable capacity, not the current energy content.
data_description.grid_power_w_entity: At the grid connection: positive = import, negative = export. Do not select inverter output power.

phase_voltages.name: Phase voltages (V)
phase_voltages.description: Select the three voltage values from your PV system's smart meter.

additional_measurements.name: Additional measurements (optional)
additional_measurements.description: Select existing sensors only; otherwise leave blank. Minimum, maximum and mean must cover the same five-minute interval.

error.invalid_smartmeter_model: Use at most 120 characters for the manufacturer and model.
error.invalid_battery_capacity: Enter a valid battery capacity greater than 0 kWh.
